tagline: Turn your own long video into a calm 2-minute short: it starts mid-thought on your best shot, every shot reframed to vertical, with serif captions that turn gold when a guest speaks.
needs: your own finished long-form video (16:9, 1080p or 4K)
readiness_note: Works from your finished long-form video only; 4K masters crop sharpest. Wide diagrams show as a centred band.

captions: Cold open: a moving render, the first serif caption already running at y 1380
Voice-coded captions: the guest's words in gold, the host's in white
A wide diagram kept whole as a centred 16:9 band over its blurred copy, caption under the band
